==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|relation|-ship|text=+|tree=1}} Displaced native {{noncog|ang|sibb}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈleɪʃ(ə)nˌʃɪp/|a=RP,GA}}
** {{audio|en|En-us-relationship.ogg|a=GA}}
*** {{IPA|en|/ɹəˈleɪʃ(ə)nˌʃɪp/|a=[[w:weak vowel merger|weak vowel merger]]}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹəˈlæ̝ɪʃ(ə)nˌʃɪp/|a=AU}}
* {{hyph|en|re|lat|ion|ship}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[connection]] or [[association]]; the condition of being [[relate]]d.
#: {{hypo|en|joking relationship}}
#: {{nearsyn|en|alliance}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Kylie Atwood|quotee=w:Mike Pompeo|title=US lifts self-imposed restrictions with Taiwan|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/01/09/asia/taiwan-us-restrictions-lifted-intl-hnk|date=2021-01-09|passage=“The United States government maintains '''relationships''' with unofficial partners around the world, and Taiwan is no exception. Our two democracies share common values of individual freedom, the rule of law, and a respect for human dignity. Today’s statement recognizes that the US-Taiwan '''relationship''' need not, and should not, be shackled by self-imposed restrictions of our permanent bureaucracy,” Pompeo wrote.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210125235533/https://www.cnn.com/2021/01/09/asia/taiwan-us-restrictions-lifted-intl-hnk/}}
# {{lb|en|mathematics}} The links between the x-values and y-values of ordered pairs of numbers especially coordinates.
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-08-10|volume=408|issue=8848|author=Schumpeter|url=http://www.economist.com/news/business/21583242-businesspeople-have-become-too-influential-government-cronies-and-capitols|title=Cronies and capitols
|passage=Policing the '''relationship''' between government and business in a free society is difficult. Businesspeople have every right to lobby governments, and civil servants to take jobs in the private sector.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170702024409/http://www.economist.com/news/business/21583242-businesspeople-have-become-too-influential-government-cronies-and-capitols|archivedate=2 July 2017}}
# {{U|kinship}}; being related by [[blood]] or [[marriage]].
# A [[romantic]] or [[sexual]] [[involvement]].
#: {{ux|en|They have been in a '''relationship''' for ten years, but have never married.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2000-04-08|author=Dorthea Straus|title=Oates on Marilyn: Men, drugs, tragedy|journal=The Baltimore Sun
|passage=Her most satisfying sexual '''relationship''' seemed to be a threesome with Charles Chaplin Jr. and Eddy Robinson Jr., the spurned sons of famous film fathers.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Sarah Molano|title=Most romantic relationships start as friendships, study finds|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/07/20/health/romantic-relationships-start-as-friends-wellness/index.html|date=2021-07-20|passage=Contrary to the popular perception that love typically sparks from passion, a new study finds two-thirds of romantic '''relationships''' begin as long-term friendships.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20250702004732/https://www.cnn.com/2021/07/20/health/romantic-relationships-start-as-friends-wellness/index.html}}
# A way in which two or more people behave and are involved with each other.
#: {{nearsyn|en|footing}}
#: {{ux|en|I have a good working '''relationship''' with my boss.}}
# {{lb|en|music}} The [[level]] or [[degree]] of [[affinity]] between [[keys]], [[chords]] and [[tones]].
